Engineering Remote Full-time

Backend Engineer

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to help scale our analytics engine to handle the next order of magnitude of data. You'll work on our core API, build new endpoints, and optimize our infrastructure for performance and reliability.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement new API endpoints and services
  • Optimize system performance and reduce latency
  • Build monitoring and observability tooling
  • Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews
  • Contribute to our infrastructure-as-code practices

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of backend engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, Go, or Rust
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices
  • Understanding of database design and optimization
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Apply for this role

Interested in this position? Send us your resume and a short note about why you'd be a great fit.
